question: Mojtaba Khamenei seen in public by July 31?
resolution_criteria:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if Supreme Leader of Iran, Mojtaba Khamenei, is photographed or videotaped between market creation and the listed date (ET). Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

For this market to resolve to "Yes," the images or video must be taken and released within this market's timeframe. The images or video must be authentic. Archival material, previously recorded footage, reused images, digitally altered content, AI-generated media, staged reproductions, or any posthumous releases will not qualify.

Digital appearances, including live broadcasts, will count for this market.

The resolution source for this market will be the image/video of Mojtaba Khamenei, and a consensus of credible reporting as to whether it is real.
research:
As of July 12, 2026, nothing settles the question. No authentic new photo or video of Mojtaba Khamenei has been released since he became Supreme Leader on March 8, 2026, and he skipped his father's funeral and burial on July 4-9. Several fetches failed because the proxy refused the connection, so many facts below come from search-result summaries.

## 1. Resolution source
- The criteria give no URL. Resolution depends on an authentic image or video taken and released within the window, plus a consensus of credible reporting. Archival or reused footage does not count; live broadcasts do.
- I could not load the Polymarket event page (connection refused), so I can't report its status directly.

## 2. Current status (as of 2026-07-12)
- Nothing qualifying has happened. Reuters, via Al Jazeera, reported no public appearance or official image since the February 28 strikes. [Al Jazeera](https://aljazeera.com/news/2026/7/5/sons-of-irans-leader-ali-khamenei-attend-funeral-but-mojtaba-is-absent)
- His messages so far have been written statements read out on state TV with old still photos. A clip IRIB aired on March 20 appears to be archival, so it would not count. [Graphic.com.gh](https://www.graphic.com.gh/international/international-news/i-dont-even-think-it-was-his-message-iranians-on-new-supreme-leaders-first-address.html), [WION](https://www.wionews.com/world/proof-of-life-or-archive-footage-iran-releases-first-video-of-mojtaba-khamenei-amid-injury-and-disfigurement-rumours-watch-1773987130959)

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-07-10: Ali Khamenei was buried privately at the Imam Reza shrine in Mashhad, and his eldest son Mostafa led the funeral prayer. Mojtaba was absent; he was reportedly injured in the same strike. [Business Today](https://www.businesstoday.in/world/story/khamenei-buried-at-mashhad-shrine-son-and-successor-mojtaba-still-absent-injured-in-same-strike-542141-2026-07-10)
- About 2026-07-08: The NYT reported that Mojtaba wanted to attend the burial and lead the prayer, but security officials refused because they feared Israel could target him. [i24](https://www.i24news.tv/en/news/middle-east/iran-eastern-states/artc-report-mojtaba-khamenei-wants-to-attend-father-s-burial-but-iran-fears-israel-could-target-him-there)
- 2026-07-05: His three brothers appeared at the Tehran funeral; Mojtaba did not. Sources said he was seriously injured, and security services are also limiting his exposure. [Al Jazeera](https://aljazeera.com/news/2026/7/5/sons-of-irans-leader-ali-khamenei-attend-funeral-but-mojtaba-is-absent), [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/05/successor-to-irans-slain-leader-khamenei-does-not-appear-at-funeral.html)
- About 2026-06-19: He conditionally approved a US-Iran ceasefire memorandum in a written message carried by state media. [FN News](https://en.fnnews.com/news/202606190600584900)
- 2026-04-10: He issued a written message saying Iran "did not seek war"; most of his statements have been read by presenters. [Naharnet](https://cdn.naharnet.com/stories/en/319451-iran-s-supreme-leader-says-does-not-seek-war-in-written-message)
- 2026-03-12: His first message was read by a TV anchor over a still photo. [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/03/12/missing-in-action-what-we-know-about-mojtaba-khameneis-condition)
- Reuters-sourced reports describe facial disfigurement and leg wounds. [WION](https://www.wionews.com/world/proof-of-life-or-archive-footage-iran-releases-first-video-of-mojtaba-khamenei-amid-injury-and-disfigurement-rumours-watch-1773987130959)

## 4. Base rates
- In more than 4 months as leader (March 8 to July 12), there have been zero verified new images or videos, even at very high-stakes moments: Nowruz, the ceasefire, and his father's funeral and burial.
- Earlier Polymarket markets in this series (March 13 and April 30) resolved No. [simplefunctions](https://simplefunctions.dev/markets/mojtaba-khamenei-public-appearance-by-may-31-polymarket-0xabef6d91ad)
- For comparison, Ali Khamenei reappeared in person about 2 weeks after the June 2025 war with Israel. [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/7/6/irans-supreme-leader-makes-first-public-appearance-since-war-with-israel)

## 5. Other forecasts
- **This market (July 31):** Crypto Briefing snapshots, which are undated and probably from late June to mid-July, put Yes between 5.5% and 10%. The figures included "5.5%, down from 11% a day ago" and "7%, down from 15% a week ago". [Crypto Briefing](https://cryptobriefing.com/iran-leadership-uncertainty-as-mojtaba-khamenei-remains-unseen-since-march-2026/), [Crypto Briefing](https://cryptobriefing.com/iran-prepares-for-khameneis-burial-amid-leadership-transition/)
- **Longer-dated markets:** the December 31 contract was at about 30-37%, including about 35% in a July 12 snapshot. A snapshot of the July 15 market showed about 75% No. I couldn't date the August 31 and September 30 snapshots, so I've left them out. [polyguana](https://polyguana.com/events/mojtaba-khamenei-public-appearance-by)
- I found no Kalshi or Manifold markets, and no expert forecasts.

## 6. Upcoming events before July 31
- Iranian media expected a Tehran memorial for Ali Khamenei on Tuesday, July 14, possibly hosted by Mojtaba. His attendance was unconfirmed, and another report gave July 23 as the date. I couldn't confirm that these reports were published by July 12. [Ground News](https://ground.news/article/ayatollah-khamenei-to-host-memorial-ceremony-for-martyred-leader), [Siasat](https://www.siasat.com/ali-khamenei-memorial-may-mark-mojtabas-first-appearance-3506072/amp/)
- The US-Iran ceasefire is fragile; renewed strikes would raise the security reasons for keeping him hidden.
- Iran could release a staged proof-of-life clip. If it were undated or unverifiable, credible reporting might dispute whether it counts.
